WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT t.translink, tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS t
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = t.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY t.translink, tr.tradekind
), pair_shares AS (
  SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count,
         record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share
  FROM pair_counts
), kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_share
  FROM pair_shares
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - type_avg_share) AS avg_excess_share
FROM kept_pairs
WHERE share > type_avg_share
GROUP BY tradekind;
